column1: # THE LINES OF THE NAME — every family of LEIBHOLZ and LUWINSKI this archive has met, kept apart.
# Begun 20 September 2026 at David's direction, on the Defranceski model: SEPARATE LINES THAT DO NOT
# YET CONNECT, HELD IN PARALLEL IN THE HOPE THAT THEY WILL.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Everything found today was found by reading one surname across many records,
# and the danger of that is the obvious one: a rare name and a shared city start to look like a
# family. This archive has been wrong that way twice in a fortnight. THE ANSWER IS NOT TO STOP
# COLLECTING THEM. It is to give each household a lane of its own, say what is documented about it,
# and say plainly what would have to be found to join it to ours — and then to leave the lanes apart
# until that thing is found.
# THE RULE THAT GOVERNS ALL OF IT, and it is David's: ONE SPELLING IS NOT A SEARCH.
#   LEIBHOLZ · LAIBHOLZ · LEIBBHOLZ · LEIBHOLTZ
#   LUWINSKI · LUWINSKY · LUWENSKI · LUWWINSKY · LOWINSKI · LOWINSKY · JUWINSKI
# Two of today's three best finds came from the variants and not from the head form.
line

column1: *** L1 · SCHUBIN, IN POSEN — AND THIS IS OURS ***
column2: SALLY (SALOMON) LEIBHOLZ, born HAMMERSTEIN 7 July 1847, married FRIEDERIKE SCHMUL at SZUBIN on 24 November 1874. Sons SAMUEL b. Schubin 28.06.1877, JACOB b. Schubin 08.08.1884, OSKAR b. Schubin 13.05.1887 — the birthplace on three separate Arolsen documents. Berlin from about 1913. ENDS: Jacob to AUSCHWITZ 26.02.1943 · Oskar to THERESIENSTADT 17.03.1943 and east on transport Er, 16.10.1944 · Samuel dead at AUSCHWITZ 10.04.1943 · Kurt to JOHANNESBURG 1933 · Siegfried to POTSDAM · Auguste to KRAICHTAL.

*** THE ODDITY AT THE HEAD OF OUR OWN LINE: SALLY WAS NOT BORN AT SCHUBIN. *** He was born at HAMMERSTEIN, in Kreis Schlochau, West Prussia, and married into Schubin. So our line begins in the same Kreis as line L3 and reaches Posen only with his marriage. THIS IS WHY L2 AND L3 ARE NOT DISMISSED.

column1: *** L2 · HAMMERSTEIN — GEORG'S ***
column2: GEORG LEIBHOLZ, born HAMMERSTEIN 7 JUNE 1884, a Wäscherei at Michaelkirchstraße 26 in Mitte, married LYDIA née PERL (daughter of Julius and Mina), deported to the ŁÓDŹ ghetto 01.11.1941 and dead at CHEŁMNO 13.05.1942 with her. NOT A BROTHER: Jacob was born at Schubin on 8 August 1884, SIXTY-TWO DAYS after him, and two sons of one mother cannot be.  ||  WHAT WOULD CONNECT IT: Georg's parents. His Yad Vashem Page has no father and no mother and gives his birthplace as the single word "Germany". His niece Irmgard Shtern turned out to be his wife's niece, not his. THE HAMMERSTEIN BIRTH REGISTER OF 1884 IS THE DOCUMENT — and Koszalin has already said it does not hold Standesamt Hammerstein for 1874-1899.

column1: *** L3 · KREIS SCHLOCHAU — PREUSSISCH FRIEDLAND ***
column2: HANS LEIBHOLZ, born PREUSSISCH FRIEDLAND 25.01.1912, "Race" JJJJ, of Danckelmannstraße 44, Charlottenburg; deported 12.01.1943, dead at AUSCHWITZ 22.02.1943. His mother ELSE née ROTHENBERG b. SCHLOCHAU 23.10.1884, his sister LISELOTT b. Preussisch Friedland 22.10.1920, and LAURA née ROTHENBERG b. 23.09.1884 in the same flat. Tracing cases 8.891, 8.892, 8.893. A STOLPERSTEIN AT THAT ADDRESS.  ||  *** SALLY LEIBHOLZ WAS BORN IN THIS KREIS. *** That is the strongest geographic tie any line has to ours, and a Kreis is not a family. WHAT WOULD CONNECT IT: the Hammerstein or Preussisch Friedland Jewish registers, which Koszalin says it does not hold at all.

column1: *** L4 · STOLP AND GLOWITZ, IN POMERANIA ***
column2: WILLI LEIBHOLZ, born STOLP IN POMMERN about 1890, a BUTCHER of Lenaustraße 25, Neukölln, married ERNA née HAMMER; children HEINZ b. 18.06.1922 and RUTH b. about 1923. Last word March 1943. Sought from Palestine in May 1946 by RUTH-TRUDE TABORI-HAMMER. And GERTRUD MEYER née LEIBHOLZ, born GLOWITZ, Kreis Stolp, 09.03.1899, on the 34th Osttransport to AUSCHWITZ, 4 March 1943.  ||  SEPARABLE BY PLACE AND BY TRADE. Stolp is 250 miles from Schubin and a different province; Willi was a butcher and Jacob a clothing merchant. The survivors who recorded this household came through the WIFE'S family, not the husband's. NOTHING WOULD CONNECT IT SHORT OF A STOLP REGISTER NAMING A SCHUBIN PARENT.

column1: *** L5 · BERLIN-BORN — AND ONE OF THEM GOT OUT ***
column2: ALBERT LEIBHOLZ, born BERLIN 17.05.1886, an antiques dealer of Halensee, ARRIVED SHANGHAI 27 JUNE 1939 and died there 18 AUGUST 1944; his wife SOPHIE née BINDER, born Berlin 19.06.1887, alive in Shanghai in 1946 and filing relief questionnaires. HEINRICH LEIBHOLZ, born Berlin 16.10.1890, a tax agent, married AGNES née KERGER; SURVIVED, died 9 August 1948, and his widow was at Mehringdamm 109 until at least 1976.  ||  Sophie called Heinrich her BROTHER-IN-LAW and she married a Leibholz, so ALBERT AND HEINRICH ARE PROBABLY BROTHERS — the one inference on this line and it is flagged. BOTH BORN IN BERLIN, which is what separates the line from ours.

column1: *** L6 · LEVETZOWSTRASSE 13 — ONE BACK-BUILDING FLAT, SIX PEOPLE ***
column2: ALFRED LEIBHOLZ b. 04.12.1887, a Fleischermeister stripped of his trade in the 1941 directory, DIED 08.08.1942; ELSE née SEELIG b. 20.07.1889, d. 17-19.08.1943; MARIANNE b. 1921, WALTER b. 1922, LIESELOTTE b. 1923 d. 06.12.1943, KURT b. 04.11.1927. Ten consecutive tracing cases, 90.465 to 90.474, opened about this one household.  ||  NO CONNECTION PROPOSED. It is here because T/D 90.474 is "LEIBHOLZ, KURT" and somebody will one day find that number and think it is Derrick's father. It is Alfred's son, born 1927.

column1: L7 · GÖTTINGEN — NOT THIS FAMILY
column2: Dr URI GERHARD LEIBHOLZ, born 15.11.1901, died at Herzberger Landstraße 55, GÖTTINGEN, 19 February 1982 — on the public record the constitutional lawyer. A survivor and not a victim.  ||  LISTED ONLY SO HE IS NOT MERGED. There is a second Gerhard Leibholz, Dr. and Dipl.-Volkswirt, in the post-war Berlin directories at Albrechtstraße 73a in Steglitz, and the two are not the same man.

column1: *** U1 · ALLENSTEIN AND SAUERBAUM — AND THIS IS OURS ***
column2: JOACHIM LUWINSKI, born ALLENSTEIN 21 October 1865, a Landwirt; JOHANNA THIMM, born SAUERBAUM (= ZERBUŃ), Kreis Rössel, 25 March 1871. Daughters AUGUSTE "LIZZY" b. Sauerbaum 28.08.1893 — the birthplace on her 1939 census card AND in her own household's Berlin registration card — and HILDA, who married Böttiger. Sommerfeld, then Charlottenburg from 24 July 1932, then ZEUTERN, where Johanna died 30.10.1955.  ||  ENDS: Kurt to JOHANNESBURG 1933 and dead there 1969 · Siegfried to POTSDAM · Auguste to KRAICHTAL, the same town her mother died in, 22 June 1975.

column1: *** U2 · ALLENSTEIN, 1874 — JOSEPH ***
column2: Standesamt OLSZTYN-ALLENSTEIN, birth entry no. 11 of 1874: MARTHA LUWENSKI, father JOSEPH, mother ELISABETH BILITEWSKI. And 1895 no. 692, Alfons Koslowski, mother GERTRUDE LUWENSKI, same registry.  ||  *** THE CLOSEST ANY LINE COMES TO OURS. *** Joachim was born in that town nine years earlier. Joseph is the right place, the right registry and the right generation TO BE HIS FATHER OR HIS BROTHER — and the family tree holds a JOSEPH LUWINSKI with no dates at all. WHAT WOULD CONNECT IT: Allenstein birth 11/1874 in full, from Archiwum Państwowe w Olsztynie, which gives Joseph's age, trade and residence; and Joachim's own 1865 birth, which is before civil registration and therefore in the Catholic register.

column1: *** U3 · KREIS RÖSSEL — SAUERBAUM'S OWN REGISTRY ***
column2: Standesamt RESZEL-RÖSSEL: FRANZ LOWINSKI, birth 68 of 1876 · ALBERT LOWINSKI, 31 of 1881 · BERNHARD LOWINSKI, 9 of 1884. The index does not carry their parents.  ||  KREIS RÖSSEL IS WHERE JOHANNA WAS BORN IN 1871 AND AUGUSTE IN 1893. A household of the name is registering children in that district between those two dates. WHAT WOULD CONNECT IT: the three entries in full — each names the father, his age, his trade and his village.

column1: *** U4 · WARTENBURG — ANTONIE ***
column2: ANTONIE LUWINSKI, married to JOHANN PIETZKOWSKI, at RUSZAJNY (Reuschhagen), Standesamt BARCZEWO-WARTENBURG: six children indexed, 1895, 1896, 1898, 1900, 1901 and 1903. THE SAME REGISTRY SPELLS HER LOWINSKI IN FOUR YEARS AND LUWINSKI IN TWO.  ||  Wartenburg is twenty kilometres from Allenstein and she is of Joachim's generation. WHAT WOULD CONNECT IT: her own marriage record, which would name her father.

column1: *** U5 · BERLIN — THE HOUSEHOLDS OF THE NAME ***
column2: 1933 is the ONLY year the surname reaches the Berlin householder section, and it holds two: ALFRED, Bügler, N31 Putbusser Straße 24, and OSKAR, SCHNEIDERMEISTER, W35 Steglitzer Straße 7. Post-war there are three men across fifteen years: MANFRED, Modellschlosser, Egellsstraße 16 in Tegel, 1957-1970 · JOACHIM, OFENSETZER, Ramlerstraße 15 in Wedding, 1967-1970 · KURT, a post-office worker and then a Beamter, 1964-1971.  ||  MANFRED AND JOACHIM ARE IN THE TREE and their parentage in it is wrong — it makes them sons of Alfred of Przasnysz, who was a Polish Catholic farm labourer. KURT IS THE TREE'S OTHER KURT, son of Leo, recorded as dying in 1995. BOTH ATTACHMENTS ARE CORRESPONDENCES AND NOT IDENTIFICATIONS. And Oskar the master tailor of 1933 is in none of the forty post-war volumes.

column1: U6 · PRZASNYSZ — NOT THIS FAMILY
column2: ALFRED LUWINSKI, born 9 September 1917 at PRZASNYSZ in Masovia, a POLISH CATHOLIC FARM LABOURER, ledig, died at SACHSENHAUSEN 11 July 1942.  ||  THE FAMILY TREE MAKES HIM THE FATHER OF MANFRED AND JOACHIM AND CITES HIS OWN CARD AS THE SOURCE. The card says otherwise in every field. Listed so the error is visible rather than quietly corrected.

column1: U7 · DEUTHEN — ANTON, AND ONE RECORD ONLY
column2: ANTON LUWINSKI, born 16.10.1919 at DEUTHEN / ALLENSTEIN, on the 1939 census at the Lehrwerkstatt Ostpreußisches Baugewerbe, Schindekopstraße 7, Königsberg. "Race" NNNN, basis of persecution unknown.  ||  DEUTHEN IS FOUR MILES FROM ALLENSTEIN and he is of the right stock to be a nephew of Joachim's. ONE RECORD, NO PARENTS, NO CONNECTION.

column1: U8 · THE HUNDRED NAMES IN THE TREE
column2: About a hundred Luwinskis in the MyHeritage export with no dates, no places and no citations — Valentinus 1774, Stanilaus 1810, Thomam 1815, Franz 1831, and a long tail of Latin forenames. This archive has always called it A SURNAME INDEX RATHER THAN A DESCENT.  ||  *** AND ON 20 SEPTEMBER IT TOUCHED A RECORD FOR THE FIRST TIME. *** The block contains a JOSEPH LUWINSKI with no dates, and line U2 is a Joseph Luwenski fathering a child at Allenstein in 1874. That is one thread, not a proof, and it is the first one.

column1: # AND THE TWO WIVES' SURNAMES, WHICH ARE LINES OF THEIR OWN AND ARE NOT YET STARTED.
SCHMUL
column2: FRIEDERIKE SCHMUL married Sally Leibholz at Szubin in 1874. Geneteka returns eighteen Schmul-family marriages in wielkopolskie and NOT ONE AT SZUBIN, and kujawsko-pomorskie holds no Jewish parish at all. A HENRIETTE ROSENFELD née SCHMUL lives in a Leibholz building at Weinstraße 6 in 1939 and WAS BORN AT SWINEMÜNDE IN POMERANIA — checked, and not ours.

column1: THIMM
column2: JOHANNA THIMM, born Sauerbaum 1871. Geneteka's East Prussian province holds FIFTY-ONE Thimm births and no Thimm at Sauerbaum, Bössau or Rössel. One Catholic family is in the right region — FRANZ THIMM and ANNA SCHMIDT of Muntowo, parish Święta Lipka, with a JOHANNA born 1859 — and the date is twelve years out and the place forty kilometres away.
